sources.name: GitHub REST API · kubernetes/kubernetes
sources.query: GET /repos/kubernetes/kubernetes, /releases (paginated), /stats/commit_activity. Official releases = non-draft, non-prerelease tags with major version >= 1. Commit months are UTC calendar months rolled up from weekly commit_activity; Nov 2025 and Nov 2026 are incomplete in the 52-week window and are excluded. Snapshot fields are a point-in-time read, not October totals.

commits.label: Commits
commits.definition: Commits on kubernetes/kubernetes, summed from GitHub commit_activity into UTC calendar months. Incomplete months at the ends of the 52-week window (2025-11 and 2026-11) are excluded.

official_releases.label: Official releases
official_releases.definition: Count of GitHub Releases in the month that are not draft or prerelease, with major version >= 1, including minor and patch tags.

minor_releases.label: Minor releases
minor_releases.definition: Official releases in the month whose patch component is 0 (for example v1.37.0).

patch_releases.label: Patch releases
patch_releases.definition: Official releases in the month whose patch component is greater than 0.

stars.label: Star
stars.definition: GitHub stargazers_count at 2026-11-24T17:22Z; a point-in-time snapshot, not an October total.

forks.label: Fork
forks.definition: GitHub forks_count at 2026-11-24T17:22Z; a point-in-time snapshot, not an October total.

open_issues_and_prs.label: Open issues (incl. PRs)
open_issues_and_prs.definition: GitHub open_issues_count, which includes open pull requests; point-in-time snapshot at 2026-11-24T17:22Z.

count.label: Release count
count.definition: One per official release tag, used for the table only; not summed into dashboard KPIs.
